wikidot5e:feat:critter-friend.effectSummary: Gain Animal Handling proficiency, or expertise if already proficient. Learn speak with animals and cast it at will without a spell slot. Learn animal friendship and cast it once without a slot per long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for both spells.

wikidot5e:feat:crossbow-expert.effectSummary: Ignore the loading property of crossbows you are proficient with. Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature does not impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls. When you take the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you may use a bonus action to attack with a hand crossbow you are holding.

wikidot5e:feat:cruel.effectSummary: Gain a number of d6 cruelty dice equal to your proficiency bonus, all restored on a long rest, and you may roll only one per turn. Spend one when you deal damage to add the die to that damage; when you score a critical hit to gain temporary HP equal to the roll; or when you make a Charisma (Intimidation) check to add the die to the check.

wikidot5e:feat:crusher.effectSummary: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1, maximum 20. Once per turn when you hit with bludgeoning damage, move the target 5 feet to an unoccupied space if it is no more than one size larger than you. When you critically hit a creature with bludgeoning damage, attacks against it have advantage until the start of your next turn.

wikidot5e:feat:diplomat.effectSummary: Increase Charisma by 1, maximum 20. Gain Persuasion proficiency, or expertise if already proficient. After speaking with a creature that understands you for 1 minute, make Charisma (Persuasion) contested by its Wisdom (Insight); the check automatically fails if you or companions are fighting it. On a success, it is charmed by you while within 60 feet and for 1 minute afterward.

wikidot5e:feat:divine-communications-ua.effectSummary: Increase by 1, maximum 20, the spellcasting ability chosen for Divinely Favored. Learn to speak, read, and write Celestial plus two languages of your choice. You can cast augury and commune without spell slots, then must finish 1d4 long rests before casting them this way again; you may also cast them with appropriate slots, using the same spellcasting ability as Divinely Favored.

wikidot5e:feat:divinely-favored.effectSummary: Learn one cleric cantrip, augury, and one 1st-level spell based on alignment: evil chooses a warlock spell, good a cleric spell, neutral a druid spell. Cast the chosen 1st-level spell and augury once each without a slot per long rest and also with appropriate spell slots. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability for these spells. You may use a holy symbol as a focus for any spell you cast using that chosen ability.

wikidot5e:feat:divinely-favored-ua.effectSummary: Learn thaumaturgy and one 1st-level spell based on alignment: evil chooses a warlock or wizard spell, good a cleric or wizard spell, neutral a druid or wizard spell. Cast the chosen spell once without a slot per long rest and also with appropriate spell slots. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the feat's spellcasting ability, and you may use a holy symbol as a focus for spells you cast using that ability.

wikidot5e:feat:dragon-fear.effectSummary: Increase Strength, Constitution, or Charisma by 1, maximum 20. Instead of using your Breath Weapon normally, expend one use to roar; chosen creatures within 30 feet that can see and hear you make Wisdom saves against DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier. On a failure they are frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save after taking damage to end the effect.

wikidot5e:feat:dragon-hide.effectSummary: Increase Strength, Constitution, or Charisma by 1, maximum 20. While unarmored, your AC can equal 13 + Dexterity modifier and still benefit from a shield. You can extend or retract claws without an action; they are natural weapons for unarmed strikes that deal 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage.
